description: This file defines the tlAttachment class, a helper class for managing attachment metadata within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, reading, and deleting attachment records, and handles attachment properties such as filename, type, size, and content.

classes.name: tlAttachment
classes.description: A class for managing attachment metadata, including creation, retrieval, and deletion of attachment records in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes an attachment object with provided metadata and content, handling empty titles based on configuration.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Reads attachment metadata from the database based on the object ID.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns attachment metadata in an array format.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Inserts or updates the attachment record in the database, encoding file contents if present.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the attachment record from the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Creates an attachment object from a database ID.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Placeholder for creating multiple attachment objects from database IDs (not implemented).

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving all attachments with optional filtering (not implemented).
